caption: Each of 2,000 meters sends 24 readings of 40 bytes a day: 48,000 readings and 1,920 kB of raw data. This daily volume is what an IoT platform must store and analyse.

spec.title: Raw data per day
spec.aria: A left-to-right flow: 2,000 meters send 24 readings a day each, producing 48,000 readings; at 40 bytes per reading and 1000 bytes per kB, the raw data is 1,920 kB per day.
